## Key Design Innovations

1. **Thin high-porosity electrodes**: 54% thinner than Chen2020 baseline with 26% higher porosity — enables 96.8% 5C retention
2. **Enhanced electrolyte transport**: t⁺ increased from 0.2594 to 0.45 — eliminates lithium plating at 4C charge
3. **Aggressive thermal management**: h=50 W/m²·K — keeps T_max below 60°C even at 4C charge
